Use case: precise-object-edit. Matching RESOLVED/SPENT state of this defiled miners' shrine game sprite. The input image is the EDIT TARGET: preserve EXACT square/rectangular canvas, camera, scale, silhouette, every masonry block, timber lintel, dark recess, wax stubs and framing. Only change the central dark stone: it now has a dull grey fracture across its upper face and a few small chips sitting immediately beside it on the sill; dark smear below it is slightly scuffed. Keep the black stone visibly present, so this generic resolved state does NOT claim it was purified, removed or smashed to pieces: the event can end after several different actions. No new candles, light, symbols, clean stonework or magical glow. Same neutral diffuse shading and chunky restrained hand-painted pixel clusters. True transparent background, no floor, no UI, no text. Entire niche inside original bounds. This should be a clearly disturbed/spent version of the same place, not a rebuilt shrine.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: ONE miners' fouled well game prop, intended for native 128x128 export, dark first-person cave crawler Depths. Isolated compact squat circular dry-stacked stone well, battered low rim, an elliptical opening seen slightly from above but front-facing overall. One short frayed rotted rope tail drapes over the near-left lip, and a broken old wooden bucket leans against the near-right base. No wooden roof, gantry, winch or long rope. Broad roughly hewn grey-brown stones and stained mortar, a few greenish damp patches. Full base and contents inside a square canvas with 8% clear margin; consistent grounded front 3/4 view like the game's treasure containers, not top-down or isometric scene. Simplified hand-painted pixel-art clusters, strong squat annular silhouette, three or four shades per material, <=64 muted slate/umber/olive/linen colours intended, few broad wear marks, no tiny noise. Neutral diffuse material shading, no cast ground shadow, firelight, magical particles or baked scenery. Genuine transparent alpha outside the entire object and bucket/rope gaps. No floor patch, labels, UI frame, text, invented rune or photoreal detail. Water should look unsafe rather than bright green poison.
